prod-backdrop-balloon-garland.notes: Balloons are faceted, sparse and arranged as a simple single row. Create a fuller organic garland with varied sizes, smoother balloons and a better-finished photo wall.

prod-backdrop-floral-arch.notes: The floral coverage is far too sparse and resembles small decorations on a bare frame rather than a full ceremony arch. Add dense layered flowers and foliage with balanced coverage.

prod-backdrop-round-arch.notes: Fabric appears as a rigid flat board rather than removable draped fabric and obscures much of the arch. Improve fabric folds, attachment, positioning and metal finish.

prod-floor-marigold-clusters.notes: Passed corrected-asset visual review on desktop and mobile.

prod-lighting-curtain.notes: The curtain is functional but too sparse and visually weak. Increase warm-light density and glow, improve wire appearance and make the top support less heavy and dark.

prod-lighting-led-candles.notes: The candles are too basic and difficult to inspect. Improve wax shapes, LED flame glow, height variation and cluster arrangement while retaining the correct true size.

prod-lighting-uplight-set.notes: The uplight is overly basic and lacks a realistic adjustable housing, bracket, lens detail and visible light-beam effect. Improve the fixture while keeping it mobile optimized.

prod-sign-mirror-welcome.notes: Passed corrected-asset visual review on desktop and mobile.
